|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Tractor Beam", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). "Piracy at its finest!" He prefers it to the [[Death Star Tractor Beam]] for mobility and versatility.
